title: Project Hours Catalog
description: Domain components for a project-hours assistant. Use together with the basic catalog for layout.

StatusPill.description: A short coloured status label, such as 'On track' or 'Over budget'.

label.description: The text shown in the pill.

tone.description: ok = within budget, warning = close to budget, over = budget exceeded.

ProjectBudgetCard.description: Shows one project's logged hours against its budget as a progress bar. The card works out the percentage and colour itself.

hoursUsed.description: Hours logged on the project so far.

budgetHours.description: Total budgeted hours for the project.

onSelect.description: Fired when the user clicks the card, for example to ask for project details.

WeekGrid.description: A timesheet grid for one week: one row per project, one column per weekday (Mon-Fri), with row and column totals and an optional approve button.

entries.description: Array of rows, each {"project": string, "hours": [mon, tue, wed, thu, fri]}. Prefer binding this to the data model with @path so the hours can be updated without resending components. To change hours, replace the whole array at that path.

approved.description: Whether the week has been approved. Hides the approve button when true.

onApprove.description: Fired when the user clicks 'Approve week'. Omit to show a read-only grid.
